methodology.llm: LangGraph + Responses function calling; fixed DAG, actual mixed Scala/Python tools, Arrow file handles; API latency included, no retries
methodology.final_output: CSV bytes SHA-256, rows and size against independent Python oracle; no final data file
methodology.file_mode: Arrow IPC intermediate files, Airflow LocalExecutor tasks exchange file paths through XCom; retries=0
methodology.stream_mode: Arrow streams, no materialization store and policy forbids materialization; only metadata/log files
methodology.host_mode: persistent, warmed JVM/Python hosts; framework startup excluded and recorded
methodology.cache: OS cache warm; no privileged cache dropping
methodology.resource_limits: each operator container 1 GiB, 128 PIDs; host not exclusively reserved; 8 concurrent tasks
methodology.input_ingestion: same CSV; file baseline uses prewrapped Arrow bytes input, XStream reads and wraps raw CSV during timing (conservative to XStream)
methodology.file_volume: sum of intermediate Arrow file lengths; not physical disk traffic
